_about: Which S1 take each new UI kit look is built from (F138). Claude's draft, 2026-10-25 (Muzzy said "go auto"): Muzzy confirms or swaps by playing .planning/research/sketches/s1-new-looks.html and pasting Copy values for Claude.

console.name: Console 1 · Living-room dashboard
console.why: The plainest reading of 'dark console': a games console's own menus — dark navy, big soft tiles, one bright blue, no outlines. It's the one most games could wear without fighting their art; the handheld is close to Cartoon, and the terminal to Pixel / Neon.

fantasy.name: Fantasy 2 · Tavern (wood & gold)
fantasy.why: Dark wood and gold with a carved-capitals title: reads 'fantasy' at a glance and stays dark, so game art and HUDs sit on it well. Parchment is a light look (the kit already has Cozy for warm light); Arcane is the most striking but its bevel + all-caps fight long text. Its accent was moved from ember red to pewter blue (hue 195) so it doesn't sit on top of the danger red.
